# 旭日云课堂 · 开发文档

> AI 可读的站点目录；正文在 Markdown 源文件中，站点只是渲染层。

## 文档

- [后端结构](https://hermannmayer.github.io/xuri-classroom/architecture/backend): API/Service/Mapper 分层、权限注解、数据范围、缓存与异常契约
- [数据模型](https://hermannmayer.github.io/xuri-classroom/architecture/data-model): 核心表、关系、软删除、迁移与生成参考
- [前台与后台的边界](https://hermannmayer.github.io/xuri-classroom/architecture/front-back-boundaries): 哪些地方前台（学员/公开侧）与后台（教职工/管理侧）没有界限：现象、代码位置、后果与收敛方向
- [前端结构](https://hermannmayer.github.io/xuri-classroom/architecture/frontend): 页面、路由、请求封装、权限判定、编辑器与主题
- [架构总览](https://hermannmayer.github.io/xuri-classroom/architecture/overview): 运行时拓扑、前后端边界、请求契约、认证、权限与部署
- [架构改造目录（2026-11）](https://hermannmayer.github.io/xuri-classroom/architecture/refactor-catalog): 从单校可用到可扩容、可多租户的分阶段改造清单：现状、目标、改动点、验收
- [功能范围](https://hermannmayer.github.io/xuri-classroom/architecture/scope): 当前做了什么、有意不做什么、已知缺口
- [没有接线的东西](https://hermannmayer.github.io/xuri-classroom/architecture/unwired-inventory): 写了但没接上的功能、配了但没读的开关、建了但没用的表：清单、证据与处理建议
- [ADR-0001 权限模型：权限点 → 角色 → 用户组/用户](https://hermannmayer.github.io/xuri-classroom/decisions/ADR-0001-rbac): 为什么组只绑角色、不直接挂权限；最终权限如何计算
- [ADR-0002 管理员 = 管理权限全集，不是所有权限串](https://hermannmayer.github.io/xuri-classroom/decisions/ADR-0002-admin-catalog): 为什么管理员不自动拥有学员能力；前端 can() 如何配合
- [ADR-0003 老师可以编辑/删除考试，但不能改题库](https://hermannmayer.github.io/xuri-classroom/decisions/ADR-0003-teacher-exam-vs-repo): 老师保留考试与问卷生命周期；题库只读；答卷删除归管理员
- [ADR-0004 单 jar 内嵌 SPA 与 MySQL 运行时](https://hermannmayer.github.io/xuri-classroom/decisions/ADR-0004-单jar内嵌SPA与MySQL运行时): 为什么安装包只发一个 jar、为什么放弃 H2、为什么 Windows 只出一个包
- [建班、加学员、分配老师、分配考试/题库与数据可见范围](https://hermannmayer.github.io/xuri-classroom/flows/class-grant)
- [从建卷/组卷到发布、答题、判分与报表](https://hermannmayer.github.io/xuri-classroom/flows/exam-publish-answer)
- [RSA 登录、sk-token 会话、注册与会话失效](https://hermannmayer.github.io/xuri-classroom/flows/login-auth)
- [权限变更流程](https://hermannmayer.github.io/xuri-classroom/flows/permission-change)
- [从题库组卷到考试](https://hermannmayer.github.io/xuri-classroom/flows/repo-compose)
- [答卷、判分与报表](https://hermannmayer.github.io/xuri-classroom/modules/answer)
- [登录与账号](https://hermannmayer.github.io/xuri-classroom/modules/auth)
- [首页与统计](https://hermannmayer.github.io/xuri-classroom/modules/dashboard)
- [任务中心、练习与错题本](https://hermannmayer.github.io/xuri-classroom/modules/exercise)
- [文件、附件与导入模板](https://hermannmayer.github.io/xuri-classroom/modules/files)
- [权限、角色与用户组](https://hermannmayer.github.io/xuri-classroom/modules/permissions)
- [考试与问卷（项目）](https://hermannmayer.github.io/xuri-classroom/modules/project)
- [题库与题目](https://hermannmayer.github.io/xuri-classroom/modules/repo)
- [考试编辑器与题型](https://hermannmayer.github.io/xuri-classroom/modules/survey)
- [班级与教学工作台](https://hermannmayer.github.io/xuri-classroom/modules/teaching)
- [接口表（生成）](https://hermannmayer.github.io/xuri-classroom/reference/api)
- [数据库结构（生成）](https://hermannmayer.github.io/xuri-classroom/reference/db-schema)
- [环境变量](https://hermannmayer.github.io/xuri-classroom/reference/env): 前端、后端、NAS 部署常用变量；不记录真实值
- [权限目录（生成）](https://hermannmayer.github.io/xuri-classroom/reference/permissions)
- [路由表（生成）](https://hermannmayer.github.io/xuri-classroom/reference/routes)
- [本地开发环境](https://hermannmayer.github.io/xuri-classroom/start/dev-setup): JDK/Node/MySQL、启动顺序、端口与构建命令
- [文档维护流程](https://hermannmayer.github.io/xuri-classroom/start/docs-workflow): 改代码时如何更新模块页、生成参考和刷新核对锚点
- [检查与测试](https://hermannmayer.github.io/xuri-classroom/start/testing): 前端类型检查、构建、规则测试、后端编译与线上冒烟
